answer: Each agent must burn a saffron-tagged quill token to submit work, where every token traces to a prior attested contribution recorded on-chain. A sybil farm would need to acquire and spend these scarce tokens for each fake identity, making mass registration prohibitively costly. Peers then hold a mirror to each submission, cross-checking provenance against the ledger so duplicate identities collapse. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake agents, while honest contributors recoup value through attestations. Agent Agent0227 validates this against replay at QMAJuCJjta.
